headline: EY Publishes on Payer AI Privacy Governance. The Framework Race Starts.
summary: EY published a framework on how healthcare payers are redesigning privacy governance for their AI programs, covering the intersection of HIPAA, state privacy laws, and emerging AI-specific regulations. This is a standard Big Four territory-staking move: free framework, paid implementation. If you have payer clients asking about AI privacy governance, you need a more operationally specific point of view than what EY's framework will offer, particularly around vendor contract audits and use-case-specific risk prioritization.
so_what: EY is publishing healthcare payer-specific AI privacy governance frameworks. This is how Big Four firms stake their consulting territory before a market matures. The framework is free. The implementation engagement is not.
original_title: How healthcare payers are redesigning privacy governance in the AI era
